blurb: The Folsom Museum is located in the old (1896) Doherty Mercantile, the museum’s interpretive displays, gift shop, and tours offer a unique view of the Hi-Lo Country and its history. Visit the events calendar to register for available tours. The Museum is open daily 9AM to 5:00PM through September 13.
